mechanism: Methylprednisolone may reduce vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis and increase vitamin K catabolism, potentially reducing the anticoagulant effect of warfarin if vitamin K supplementation is used concurrently.
action: Monitor INR closely if vitamin K supplementation is added or removed in patients on concurrent anticoagulation; vitamin K supplementation is generally safe with methylprednisolone alone but requires careful monitoring in triple therapy scenarios.
